4. X's songs have soundtracked some of the most iconic scenes in cinema: Jack Black belting one in High Fidelity, the opening of The Big Chill, the locker room of Remember the Titans, the San Francisco dread of Zodiac, to name a few.
At the time of X's death, he was $1.9 million in debt: $600,000 in unpaid federal taxes, $300,000 in back alimony to each of two ex-wives, and mounting legal costs. X was also deep in cocaine and PCP addiction. All the reasons why X's siblings believed the death was not an accident but a "premeditated suicide." X's sister later said: "X accomplished three things - put himself out of his misery, brought relief to Mother by finally getting her husband out of her life. And punished Father, by making certain that the rest of his life would be miserable." X's brother, who held him in the final moments, reported that his last words were: "I got what I wanted. I couldn't do it myself, so I made him do it." In fact, the weapon used was one X had given to his father as a gift months earlier. X died one day before his 45th birthday. ID X.
